key: Only part of the invoice was paid.
english: Only part of the invoice was paid.
draft: Slegs 'n deel van die faktuur is betaal.

key: The buyer paid a deposit. Which action keeps the record honest?
english: The buyer paid a deposit. Which action keeps the record honest?
draft: Die koper het 'n deposito betaal. Watter aksie hou die rekord eerlik?

key: A deposit is not full payment. That would hide the amount still owed.
english: A deposit is not full payment. That would hide the amount still owed.
draft: 'n Deposito is nie volle betaling nie. Dit sou die bedrag wat nog verskuldig is, verberg.

key: Keep the part payment and balance in a supporting record
english: Keep the part payment and balance in a supporting record
draft: Hou die gedeeltelike betaling en saldo in 'n ondersteunende rekord

key: Create another sale for the deposit
english: Create another sale for the deposit
draft: Skep nog 'n verkoping vir die deposito

key: A deposit towards the existing invoice is not a second sale. Keep it linked in your supporting payment record.
english: A deposit towards the existing invoice is not a second sale. Keep it linked in your supporting payment record.
draft: 'n Deposito op die bestaande faktuur is nie 'n tweede verkoping nie. Hou dit gekoppel in jou ondersteunende betaalrekord.

key: A paid label is a record, not independent proof
english: A paid label is a record, not independent proof
draft: 'n Betaal-etiket is 'n rekord, nie onafhanklike bewys nie

key: The app relies on the payment details you enter. It does not check your bank account or establish that a transfer cleared. Keep the evidence that supports your update.
english: The app relies on the payment details you enter. It does not check your bank account or establish that a transfer cleared. Keep the evidence that supports your update.
draft: Die app maak staat op die betaalbesonderhede wat jy invoer. Dit kontroleer nie jou bankrekening nie en bewys nie dat 'n oorplasing deurgegaan het nie. Hou die bewyse wat jou bywerking ondersteun.

key: Find the invoice you want to review
english: Find the invoice you want to review
draft: Vind die faktuur wat jy wil hersien

key: Open Saved, match the reference and compare the payment evidence. Follow the same record through review and sharing.
english: Open Saved, match the reference and compare the payment evidence. Follow the same record through review and sharing.
draft: Maak Gestoor oop, pas die verwysing en vergelyk die betaalbewyse. Volg dieselfde rekord deur hersiening en deel.

key: For your own records, have a receipt, sale or harvest entry to compare. Read loading, offline and save messages before deciding that a missing figure means zero. Keep private customer and banking details out of group practice.
english: For your own records, have a receipt, sale or harvest entry to compare. Read loading, offline and save messages before deciding that a missing figure means zero. Keep private customer and banking details out of group practice.
draft: Vir jou eie rekords, hou 'n kwitansie-, verkoping- of oesinskrywing gereed om te vergelyk. Lees laai-, vanlyn- en stoorboodskappe voordat jy besluit dat 'n ontbrekende syfer nul beteken. Hou private kliënt- en bankbesonderhede uit groepoefening.

key: Charts → Cash flow → 6m, 12m or 24m
english: Charts → Cash flow → 6m, 12m or 24m
draft: Grafieke → Kontantvloei → 6m, 12m of 24m

key: The buttons choose how many months the Cash flow graph shows. Read the dates on that graph. Tap a month to inspect its money in, money out and running total.
english: The buttons choose how many months the Cash flow graph shows. Read the dates on that graph. Tap a month to inspect its money in, money out and running total.
draft: Die knoppies kies hoeveel maande die Kontantvloei-grafiek wys. Lees die datums op daardie grafiek. Tik op 'n maand om sy geld in, geld uit en lopende totaal te ondersoek.

key: Cash flow → Money in, money out and the lower running-total band
english: Cash flow → Money in, money out and the lower running-total band
draft: Kontantvloei → Geld in, geld uit en die onderste band met die lopende totaal

key: The running total starts at zero at the left edge of the selected window. It adds recorded money in and subtracts recorded spending across those months. It is not your bank balance, because it has no opening bank balance.
english: The running total starts at zero at the left edge of the selected window. It adds recorded money in and subtracts recorded spending across those months. It is not your bank balance, because it has no opening bank balance.
draft: Die lopende totaal begin by nul aan die linkerkant van die gekose tydperk. Dit tel aangetekende geld in by en trek aangetekende besteding af oor daardie maande. Dit is nie jou banksaldo nie, want dit het geen openingsbanksaldo nie.

key: Read picked, sold and the remainder
english: Read picked, sold and the remainder
draft: Lees gepluk, verkoop en die res

key: Harvest graphs → Picked & sold → Read the month and orchard setting
english: Harvest graphs → Picked & sold → Read the month and orchard setting
draft: Oesgrafieke → Gepluk en verkoop → Lees die maand en boordinstelling

key: Check the selected window and whether Orchard in or Orchard out is shown. That setting changes which kilograms are counted; it does not remove all those activities from the money totals.
english: Check the selected window and whether Orchard in or Orchard out is shown. That setting changes which kilograms are counted; it does not remove all those activities from the money totals.
draft: Kontroleer die gekose tydperk en of Boord ingesluit of Boord uitgesluit gewys word. Daardie instelling verander watter kilogram getel word; dit verwyder nie al daardie aktiwiteite uit die geldtotale nie.

key: Kept is the picked-minus-sold remainder in the records. It does not identify how much was eaten, given away, stored, used elsewhere or lost. Keep those destinations separately when needed.
english: Kept is the picked-minus-sold remainder in the records. It does not identify how much was eaten, given away, stored, used elsewhere or lost. Keep those destinations separately when needed.
draft: Gehou is die res van gepluk minus verkoop in die rekords. Dit identifiseer nie hoeveel geëet, weggegee, geberg, elders gebruik of verloor is nie. Hou daardie bestemmings afsonderlik wanneer nodig.

key: This card uses recorded sales minus assigned costs and today’s mapped area. Its square metres are not a historical measurement of harvested ground.
english: This card uses recorded sales minus assigned costs and today’s mapped area. Its square metres are not a historical measurement of harvested ground.
draft: Hierdie kaart gebruik aangetekende verkope minus toegewysde koste en vandag se gekarteerde oppervlakte. Sy vierkante meter is nie 'n historiese meting van geoeste grond nie.

key: Read the shared-cost and unassigned-cost notes. Missing overheads or labour are not silently included. Crop performance may say Cost per m²: not attributed rather than supplying a full crop profit.
english: Read the shared-cost and unassigned-cost notes. Missing overheads or labour are not silently included. Crop performance may say Cost per m²: not attributed rather than supplying a full crop profit.
draft: Lees die notas oor gedeelde koste en ontoegewysde koste. Ontbrekende oorhoofse koste of arbeid word nie stilweg ingesluit nie. Gewasprestasie kan Koste per m²: nie toegeskryf nie sê eerder as om 'n volledige gewaswins te verskaf.

key: You can name an included cost, an excluded or unknown cost, and the area used.
english: You can name an included cost, an excluded or unknown cost, and the area used.
draft: Jy kan 'n ingesluite koste, 'n uitgeslote of onbekende koste en die gebruikte oppervlakte noem.

key: My Records → Sold, Spent or Picked → Reopen the source record
english: My Records → Sold, Spent or Picked → Reopen the source record
draft: My rekords → Verkoop, Bestee of Gepluk → Maak die bronrekord weer oop

key: Choose one amount or harvest and find its record. On a wide screen, the Financial sheet also lists dated entries with invoice and receipt links. Reopen the matching document instead of adding another entry.
english: Choose one amount or harvest and find its record. On a wide screen, the Financial sheet also lists dated entries with invoice and receipt links. Reopen the matching document instead of adding another entry.
draft: Kies een bedrag of oes en vind sy rekord. Op 'n breë skerm lys die Finansiële staat ook gedateerde inskrywings met faktuur- en kwitansieskakels. Maak die ooreenstemmende dokument weer oop in plaas daarvan om nog 'n inskrywing by te voeg.

key: Write down one question the evidence can answer and one gap still to resolve. Follow the harvest, expense or invoice guide if an actual supported entry needs correction.
english: Write down one question the evidence can answer and one gap still to resolve. Follow the harvest, expense or invoice guide if an actual supported entry needs correction.
draft: Skryf een vraag neer wat die bewyse kan beantwoord en een gaping wat nog opgelos moet word. Volg die oes-, uitgawe- of faktuurgids as 'n werklike ondersteunde inskrywing reggestel moet word.

key: The selected cash-flow window shows −R50.00. Does that prove the bank account is overdrawn?
english: The selected cash-flow window shows −R50.00. Does that prove the bank account is overdrawn?
draft: Die gekose kontantvloeitydperk wys −R50.00. Bewys dit dat die bankrekening oortrokke is?

key: Correct. The chart shows the net movement of its included records. Reconcile the account separately before concluding what cash is available.
english: Correct. The chart shows the net movement of its included records. Reconcile the account separately before concluding what cash is available.
draft: Korrek. Die grafiek wys die netto beweging van sy ingesluite rekords. Rekonsilieer die rekening afsonderlik voordat jy besluit watter kontant beskikbaar is.

key: Add an extra sale to bring it above zero
english: Add an extra sale to bring it above zero
draft: Voeg 'n ekstra verkoping by om dit bo nul te bring

key: Charts helps you investigate recorded cash, harvests and planning assumptions. It does not produce a complete balance sheet, stock valuation, bank reconciliation or tax return.
english: Charts helps you investigate recorded cash, harvests and planning assumptions. It does not produce a complete balance sheet, stock valuation, bank reconciliation or tax return.
draft: Grafieke help jou om aangetekende kontant, oeste en beplanningsaannames te ondersoek. Dit lewer nie 'n volledige balansstaat, voorraadwaardasie, bankrekonsiliasie of belastingopgawe nie.

key: Keep checked supporting schedules for amounts the app does not track, and ask for appropriate bookkeeping help with complete accounts. A map, chart or export does not prove profitability or funding approval.
english: Keep checked supporting schedules for amounts the app does not track, and ask for appropriate bookkeeping help with complete accounts. A map, chart or export does not prove profitability or funding approval.
draft: Hou nagegaande ondersteunende skedules vir bedrae wat die app nie byhou nie, en vra gepaste boekhouhulp met volledige rekeninge. 'n Kaart, grafiek of uitvoer bewys nie winsgewendheid of goedkeuring van befondsing nie.

key: Have the period you need, your invoices, receipts and payment records ready. First check which farm and account you are using.
english: Have the period you need, your invoices, receipts and payment records ready. First check which farm and account you are using.
draft: Hou die tydperk wat jy nodig het, jou fakture, kwitansies en betaalrekords gereed. Kontroleer eers watter plaas en rekening jy gebruik.

key: Charts can export a CSV: a table that a spreadsheet app can open. It contains dated harvest, sale, paid-invoice and cost rows for its selected period.
english: Charts can export a CSV: a table that a spreadsheet app can open. It contains dated harvest, sale, paid-invoice and cost rows for its selected period.
draft: Grafieke kan 'n CSV uitvoer: 'n tabel wat 'n sigbladapp kan oopmaak. Dit bevat gedateerde rye vir oeste, verkope, betaalde fakture en koste vir sy gekose tydperk.

key: Picked has Records for a lender: a PDF summary of the records entered. It is useful for discussing those records. It is not a credit score or loan approval.
english: Picked has Records for a lender: a PDF summary of the records entered. It is useful for discussing those records. It is not a credit score or loan approval.
draft: Gepluk het Rekords vir 'n lener: 'n PDF-opsomming van die rekords wat ingevoer is. Dit is nuttig om daardie rekords te bespreek. Dit is nie 'n kredietpunt of lening-goedkeuring nie.

key: Neither file is a complete backup of the app. Keep original invoices, receipt photos and other evidence separately.
english: Neither file is a complete backup of the app. Keep original invoices, receipt photos and other evidence separately.
draft: Geeneen van die lêers is 'n volledige rugsteun van die app nie. Hou oorspronklike fakture, kwitansiefoto's en ander bewyse afsonderlik.

key: Match a row to its saved invoice, harvest or receipt. Keep its units: a bunch is not a kilogram. A harvest row records produce, not money received. Paid invoices use the recorded payment date; unpaid invoices are not cash income here.
english: Match a row to its saved invoice, harvest or receipt. Keep its units: a bunch is not a kilogram. A harvest row records produce, not money received. Paid invoices use the recorded payment date; unpaid invoices are not cash income here.
draft: Pas 'n ry by sy gestoorde faktuur, oes of kwitansie. Hou sy eenhede: 'n bossie is nie 'n kilogram nie. 'n Oesry teken produkte aan, nie geld ontvang nie. Betaalde fakture gebruik die aangetekende betaaldatum; onbetaalde fakture is hier nie kontantinkomste nie.

key: View summary shows monthly income, costs and balance. The cash summary covers up to twelve months including the current month, starting no earlier than the first dated sale, paid invoice or cost in your records.
english: View summary shows monthly income, costs and balance. The cash summary covers up to twelve months including the current month, starting no earlier than the first dated sale, paid invoice or cost in your records.
draft: Bekyk opsomming wys maandelikse inkomste, koste en saldo. Die kontantopsomming dek tot twaalf maande, insluitend die huidige maand, en begin nie vroeër as die eerste gedateerde verkoping, betaalde faktuur of koste in jou rekords nie.

key: The harvest and sales track record can cover different dates from the monthly cash summary. Read the dates in each section. A blank or zero in these records does not prove that nothing happened outside the app.
english: The harvest and sales track record can cover different dates from the monthly cash summary. Read the dates in each section. A blank or zero in these records does not prove that nothing happened outside the app.
draft: Die oes- en verkooprekord kan ander datums dek as die maandelikse kontantopsomming. Lees die datums in elke afdeling. 'n Leë of nul in hierdie rekords bewys nie dat niks buite die app gebeur het nie.

key: Keep invoices, receipts and checked payment records beside the exported files. A CSV does not include the original receipt pictures or complete invoice documents.
english: Keep invoices, receipts and checked payment records beside the exported files. A CSV does not include the original receipt pictures or complete invoice documents.
draft: Hou fakture, kwitansies en nagegaande betaalrekords langs die uitgevoerde lêers. 'n CSV sluit nie die oorspronklike kwitansiefoto's of volledige faktuurdokumente in nie.

key: Write down missing costs, unpaid amounts and records entered late. The harvest and cost forms use the entry date, so keep the original event date in your supporting papers too.
english: Write down missing costs, unpaid amounts and records entered late. The harvest and cost forms use the entry date, so keep the original event date in your supporting papers too.
draft: Skryf ontbrekende koste, onbetaalde bedrae en rekords wat laat ingevoer is, neer. Die oes- en kostevorms gebruik die inskrywingsdatum, so hou ook die oorspronklike gebeurtenisdatum in jou ondersteunende papiere.

key: Income minus the costs entered is not complete profit or your bank balance. The app cannot include costs you have not recorded, or check your bank for you. Explain what is missing instead of filling gaps with guesses.
english: Income minus the costs entered is not complete profit or your bank balance. The app cannot include costs you have not recorded, or check your bank for you. Explain what is missing instead of filling gaps with guesses.
draft: Inkomste minus die ingevoerde koste is nie volledige wins of jou banksaldo nie. Die app kan nie koste insluit wat jy nie aangeteken het nie, of jou bank vir jou nagaan nie. Verduidelik wat ontbreek in plaas daarvan om gapings met raaiskote te vul.

key: The fieldwork queue and money book have separate save systems. No entries in the fieldwork queue does not prove that every financial record has synchronised. Follow the result shown by the feature you used.
english: The fieldwork queue and money book have separate save systems. No entries in the fieldwork queue does not prove that every financial record has synchronised. Follow the result shown by the feature you used.
draft: Die veldwerk-tou en geldboek het afsonderlike stoorstelsels. Geen inskrywings in die veldwerk-tou bewys nie dat elke finansiële rekord gesinkroniseer het nie. Volg die resultaat wat gewys word deur die funksie wat jy gebruik het.

key: BRIEF-A in the busy-yard case prioritises food, clear access and manageable care. The household has not asked for animals. RESOURCES-A has no budget or care-time figures. The learner writes “confirm care time and costs”, not an invented amount, and keeps the route in the brief.
english: BRIEF-A in the busy-yard case prioritises food, clear access and manageable care. The household has not asked for animals. RESOURCES-A has no budget or care-time figures. The learner writes “confirm care time and costs”, not an invented amount, and keeps the route in the brief.
draft: BRIEF-A in die besige-werf-geval gee voorrang aan kos, duidelike toegang en hanteerbare versorging. Die huishouding het nie vir diere gevra nie. RESOURCES-A het geen begroting- of versorgingstydsyfers nie. Die leerder skryf “bevestig versorgingstyd en koste”, nie 'n versinde bedrag nie, en hou die roete in die opdrag.

key: Busy-yard concept A improves care of the existing patch while preserving access. Concept B investigates a different location, also preserving access. B must still answer the water report, shade, soil, measurement and care questions; A must still answer whether the existing patch can meet the household's priorities. Neither receives a promised harvest or invented cost advantage.
english: Busy-yard concept A improves care of the existing patch while preserving access. Concept B investigates a different location, also preserving access. B must still answer the water report, shade, soil, measurement and care questions; A must still answer whether the existing patch can meet the household's priorities. Neither receives a promised harvest or invented cost advantage.
draft: Besige-werf-konsep A verbeter die versorging van die bestaande kol terwyl toegang behou word. Konsep B ondersoek 'n ander ligging en behou ook toegang. B moet steeds die vrae oor die waterverslag, skadu, grond, metings en versorging beantwoord; A moet steeds beantwoord of die bestaande kol aan die huishouding se prioriteite kan voldoen. Geeneen kry 'n beloofde oes of 'n versinde kostevoordeel nie.

key: Can a concept be called cheaper when its material quantities and costs are missing?
english: Can a concept be called cheaper when its material quantities and costs are missing?
draft: Kan 'n konsep goedkoper genoem word wanneer sy materiaalhoeveelhede en koste ontbreek?

key: no. **Reason:** “cost unknown” must stay visible until a comparable estimate is supported.
english: no. **Reason:** “cost unknown” must stay visible until a comparable estimate is supported.
draft: nee. **Rede:** “koste onbekend” moet sigbaar bly totdat 'n vergelykbare skatting ondersteun word.

key: The busy-yard household provisionally prefers investigating improvements to the existing patch because the brief values manageable care and keeping access. This is not proof of lower cost or higher yield. Relocation remains available if later measurements or site assessment show the existing patch cannot meet the brief.
english: The busy-yard household provisionally prefers investigating improvements to the existing patch because the brief values manageable care and keeping access. This is not proof of lower cost or higher yield. Relocation remains available if later measurements or site assessment show the existing patch cannot meet the brief.
draft: Die besige-werf-huishouding verkies voorlopig om verbeterings aan die bestaande kol te ondersoek omdat die opdrag hanteerbare versorging en die behoud van toegang waardeer. Dit is nie bewys van laer koste of hoër opbrengs nie. Verskuiwing bly beskikbaar as latere metings of terreinbeoordeling toon dat die bestaande kol nie aan die opdrag kan voldoen nie.

key: The busy-yard proposal keeps the route visible, but the learner still checks it with its users. A new tank remains only an idea: water demand, supply, siting, support, cost and overflow are not established. The design can progress in other areas while that proposal remains unresolved.
english: The busy-yard proposal keeps the route visible, but the learner still checks it with its users. A new tank remains only an idea: water demand, supply, siting, support, cost and overflow are not established. The design can progress in other areas while that proposal remains unresolved.
draft: Die besige-werf-voorstel hou die roete sigbaar, maar die leerder kontroleer dit steeds met die gebruikers daarvan. 'n Nuwe tenk bly net 'n idee: watervraag, -voorsiening, plasing, ondersteuning, koste en oorloop is nie vasgestel nie. Die ontwerp kan in ander areas vorder terwyl daardie voorstel onopgelos bly.

key: Mapping, design and exports guides. Compare the saved dimensions and exported view; preserve the original geometry when improving presentation. No paid render is required.
english: Mapping, design and exports guides. Compare the saved dimensions and exported view; preserve the original geometry when improving presentation. No paid render is required.
draft: Karterings-, ontwerp- en uitvoergidse. Vergelyk die gestoorde afmetings en uitgevoerde aansig; bewaar die oorspronklike meetkunde wanneer jy die aanbieding verbeter. Geen betaalde weergawe is nodig nie.

key: The drawing includes a tank and fence, but the budget has only a plant purchase. Does the budget describe the plan?
english: The drawing includes a tank and fence, but the budget has only a plant purchase. Does the budget describe the plan?
draft: Die tekening sluit 'n tenk en heining in, maar die begroting het net 'n plantaankoop. Beskryf die begroting die plan?

key: RESOURCES-A contains no prices, quantities or committed labour. The busy-yard learner creates an unknown-cost register with evidence needed for each proposed change. They cannot claim that concept A is affordable merely because it retains the old patch.
english: RESOURCES-A contains no prices, quantities or committed labour. The busy-yard learner creates an unknown-cost register with evidence needed for each proposed change. They cannot claim that concept A is affordable merely because it retains the old patch.
draft: RESOURCES-A bevat geen pryse, hoeveelhede of toegesegde arbeid nie. Die besige-werf-leerder skep 'n register van onbekende koste met die bewyse wat vir elke voorgestelde verandering nodig is. Hulle kan nie beweer dat konsep A bekostigbaar is net omdat dit die ou kol behou nie.

key: Choose a proposed item and trace it from the plan to its quantity source, quotation or unknown, payment timing and care cost. State what the current record includes and excludes. Compare the first phase with available resources before committing to it.
english: Choose a proposed item and trace it from the plan to its quantity source, quotation or unknown, payment timing and care cost. State what the current record includes and excludes. Compare the first phase with available resources before committing to it.
draft: Kies 'n voorgestelde item en volg dit van die plan na sy hoeveelheidsbron, kwotasie of onbekende, betaaltyd en versorgingskoste. Sê wat die huidige rekord insluit en uitsluit. Vergelyk die eerste fase met beskikbare hulpbronne voordat jy daartoe verbind.

key: The plan and budget describe the same scope; the learner preserves exclusions, unknowns and cash timing. No purchase is needed to demonstrate the method.
english: The plan and budget describe the same scope; the learner preserves exclusions, unknowns and cash timing. No purchase is needed to demonstrate the method.
draft: Die plan en begroting beskryf dieselfde omvang; die leerder bewaar uitsluitings, onbekendes en kontanttydsberekening. Geen aankoop is nodig om die metode te demonstreer nie.

key: Finance, expenses and crop-planning guides. Use classroom/sample records for practice and keep unknowns visible where an app field cannot represent them safely. The guide is not a substitute for the design's care plan.
english: Finance, expenses and crop-planning guides. Use classroom/sample records for practice and keep unknowns visible where an app field cannot represent them safely. The guide is not a substitute for the design's care plan.
draft: Finansies-, uitgawe- en gewasbeplanningsgidse. Gebruik klaskamer-/voorbeeldrekords om te oefen en hou onbekendes sigbaar waar 'n app-veld dit nie veilig kan voorstel nie. Die gids is nie 'n plaasvervanger vir die ontwerp se versorgingsplan nie.

key: Does a photograph establish that income increased?
english: Does a photograph establish that income increased?
draft: Bewys 'n foto dat inkomste toegeneem het?

key: If later busy-yard evidence shows that the preferred option cannot preserve access, the learner returns to the alternatives. That is a conditional teaching example, not a reported event. The revision would update the plan, decision record, cost scope and care discussion together.
english: If later busy-yard evidence shows that the preferred option cannot preserve access, the learner returns to the alternatives. That is a conditional teaching example, not a reported event. The revision would update the plan, decision record, cost scope and care discussion together.
draft: As latere besige-werf-bewyse toon dat die voorkeuropsie nie toegang kan behou nie, gaan die leerder terug na die alternatiewe. Dit is 'n voorwaardelike onderrigvoorbeeld, nie 'n gerapporteerde gebeurtenis nie. Die hersiening sou die plan, besluitrekord, kosteomvang en versorgingsgesprek saam bywerk.

key: no. **Reason:** linked quantities, cost assumptions and implementation information must also be checked.
english: no. **Reason:** linked quantities, cost assumptions and implementation information must also be checked.
draft: nee. **Rede:** gekoppelde hoeveelhede, koste-aannames en implementeringsinligting moet ook nagegaan word.

key: Put down the opening-balance card: R1,000. Add C01, the owner's R300 contribution. Count R1,300. Put C01 under “Owner added money”, not “Produce sold”. Remove C02, R120 paid for packaging: R1,180 remains. Add C03, R200 cash sale: R1,380 remains. Point back to the reasons, not only the final total.
english: Put down the opening-balance card: R1,000. Add C01, the owner's R300 contribution. Count R1,300. Put C01 under “Owner added money”, not “Produce sold”. Remove C02, R120 paid for packaging: R1,180 remains. Add C03, R200 cash sale: R1,380 remains. Point back to the reasons, not only the final total.
draft: Sit die openingsaldo-kaart neer: R1,000. Voeg C01 by, die eienaar se bydrae van R300. Tel R1,300. Sit C01 onder “Eienaar het geld bygevoeg”, nie “Produkte verkoop” nie. Haal C02 weg, R120 betaal vir verpakking: R1,180 bly oor. Voeg C03 by, 'n kontantverkoping van R200: R1,380 bly oor. Wys terug na die redes, nie net na die finale totaal nie.

key: A grower sells produce for R90 and then takes R30 home. Ask separately: “What was the sale?” and “How much of that cash remains at the farm?” Answers: R90 sale; R60 remains from that receipt. R60 is not the sale value and is not a calculation of profit. Then ask where the R30 should be visible: in the household-withdrawal record.
english: A grower sells produce for R90 and then takes R30 home. Ask separately: “What was the sale?” and “How much of that cash remains at the farm?” Answers: R90 sale; R60 remains from that receipt. R60 is not the sale value and is not a calculation of profit. Then ask where the R30 should be visible: in the household-withdrawal record.
draft: 'n Kweker verkoop produkte vir R90 en neem dan R30 huis toe. Vra afsonderlik: “Wat was die verkoping?” en “Hoeveel van daardie kontant bly by die plaas?” Antwoorde: R90-verkoping; R60 bly oor van daardie ontvangs. R60 is nie die verkoopwaarde nie en is nie 'n berekening van wins nie. Vra dan waar die R30 sigbaar moet wees: in die rekord van huishoudelike onttrekkings.

key: If the learner reports a R60 sale, place the buyer's R90 payment card beside the R30 withdrawal card. Keep both events visible and ask again. If the learner calls the contribution a sale, ask what produce the owner bought. In this card they bought none.
english: If the learner reports a R60 sale, place the buyer's R90 payment card beside the R30 withdrawal card. Keep both events visible and ask again. If the learner calls the contribution a sale, ask what produce the owner bought. In this card they bought none.
draft: As die leerder 'n verkoping van R60 rapporteer, sit die koper se betaalkaart van R90 langs die onttrekkingskaart van R30. Hou albei gebeure sigbaar en vra weer. As die leerder die bydrae 'n verkoping noem, vra watter produkte die eienaar gekoop het. Op hierdie kaart het hulle niks gekoop nie.

key: Make headings for farm sales, farm purchases, owner contributions and household withdrawals in a notebook. Use a private record or new practice cards. No personal amounts need to be shared in class.
english: Make headings for farm sales, farm purchases, owner contributions and household withdrawals in a notebook. Use a private record or new practice cards. No personal amounts need to be shared in class.
draft: Maak opskrifte vir plaasverkope, plaasaankope, eienaarsbydraes en huishoudelike onttrekkings in 'n notaboek. Gebruik 'n private rekord of nuwe oefenkaarte. Geen persoonlike bedrae hoef in die klas gedeel te word nie.

key: If cash is given as R240, cover the unpaid R140 card and ask what money arrived. If sales are given as R340, place the payment beneath its existing sale instead of adding it as a new sale. Check with a new example, R180 sale and R60 received: R120 remains owed.
english: If cash is given as R240, cover the unpaid R140 card and ask what money arrived. If sales are given as R340, place the payment beneath its existing sale instead of adding it as a new sale. Check with a new example, R180 sale and R60 received: R120 remains owed.
draft: As kontant as R240 gegee word, bedek die onbetaalde R140-kaart en vra watter geld opgedaag het. As verkope as R340 gegee word, plaas die betaling onder sy bestaande verkoping in plaas daarvan om dit as 'n nuwe verkoping by te voeg. Kontroleer met 'n nuwe voorbeeld, 'n verkoping van R180 en R60 ontvang: R120 bly verskuldig.

key: Using practice or redacted evidence, connect one sale to its payment. Preserve both dates when they differ. If the payment cannot be found, keep the status unresolved and name the evidence you need.
english: Using practice or redacted evidence, connect one sale to its payment. Preserve both dates when they differ. If the payment cannot be found, keep the status unresolved and name the evidence you need.
draft: Koppel een verkoping aan sy betaling met behulp van oefen- of geredigeerde bewyse. Bewaar albei datums wanneer hulle verskil. As die betaling nie gevind kan word nie, hou die status onopgelos en noem die bewyse wat jy nodig het.

key: Give these independent cards: (a) a receipt says 2.5 kg, entry says 2.5 bunches; (b) source says R12.50, entry says R125; (c) transport receipt missing, entry says zero. Learners identify the unit, decimal and missing-evidence errors. Correct (a) and (b) from their sources. For (c), leave the cost unknown until evidence is obtained; a plausible amount is not evidence. These are new error-finding exercises, not additional events in the cash table below.
english: Give these independent cards: (a) a receipt says 2.5 kg, entry says 2.5 bunches; (b) source says R12.50, entry says R125; (c) transport receipt missing, entry says zero. Learners identify the unit, decimal and missing-evidence errors. Correct (a) and (b) from their sources. For (c), leave the cost unknown until evidence is obtained; a plausible amount is not evidence. These are new error-finding exercises, not additional events in the cash table below.
draft: Gee hierdie onafhanklike kaarte: (a) 'n kwitansie sê 2.5 kg, die inskrywing sê 2.5 bossies; (b) die bron sê R12.50, die inskrywing sê R125; (c) vervoerkwitansie ontbreek, die inskrywing sê nul. Leerders identifiseer die eenheid-, desimaal- en ontbrekende-bewyse-foute. Stel (a) en (b) reg uit hul bronne. Laat vir (c) die koste onbekend totdat bewyse verkry is; 'n aanneemlike bedrag is nie bewyse nie. Dit is nuwe foutsoekoefeninge, nie bykomende gebeure in die kontanttabel hieronder nie.

key: Put down four counters for opening stock, then add H01's 16 kg. Twenty kilograms are now available. Move six counters to Sold for delivery D01 and two to Home for HOME01. Twelve remain. Read the source reference as you write each row. The sold quantity belongs to sale S01; the home quantity is not another sale or a cash receipt.

Read the source reference as you write each row. The sold quantity belongs to sale S01; the home quantity is not another sale or a cash receipt.
draft: Sit vier tellers neer vir openingsvoorraad, en voeg dan H01 se 16 kg by. Twintig kilogram is nou beskikbaar. Skuif ses tellers na Verkoop vir aflewering D01 en twee na Tuis vir HOME01. Twaalf bly oor. Lees die bronverwysing terwyl jy elke ry skryf. Die verkoopte hoeveelheid behoort aan verkoping S01; die tuishoeveelheid is nie nog 'n verkoping of 'n kontantontvangs nie.

key: Read S02: 5 kg delivered on Day 2 for R100.00. Nothing is paid that day. Put R100.00 in “Buyer B owes”. On Day 4, PAY02 shows R60.00 received into the wallet for S02. Move R60.00 out of the owed amount and into wallet receipts; R40.00 remains owed. Sale value stays R100.00 and delivered weight stays 5 kg. The payment has not produced another delivery.
english: Read S02: 5 kg delivered on Day 2 for R100.00. Nothing is paid that day. Put R100.00 in “Buyer B owes”. On Day 4, PAY02 shows R60.00 received into the wallet for S02. Move R60.00 out of the owed amount and into wallet receipts; R40.00 remains owed. Sale value stays R100.00 and delivered weight stays 5 kg. The payment has not produced another delivery.
draft: Lees S02: 5 kg afgelewer op Dag 2 vir R100.00. Niks word daardie dag betaal nie. Sit R100.00 in “Koper B skuld”. Op Dag 4 wys PAY02 R60.00 ontvang in die beursie vir S02. Skuif R60.00 uit die verskuldigde bedrag en na beursie-ontvangste; R40.00 bly verskuldig. Verkoopwaarde bly R100.00 en afgelewerde gewig bly 5 kg. Die betaling het nie nog 'n aflewering opgelewer nie.

key: Complete all seven money rows. The farm receives R260.00 from buyers and pays R45.00 in documented costs. Combined money changes from R600.00 to R815.00. Sales total R300.00; R40.00 remains owed on S02. Neither R815.00 nor R215.00 is established accounting profit. The pack omits production costs and stock values needed for that conclusion.
english: Complete all seven money rows. The farm receives R260.00 from buyers and pays R45.00 in documented costs. Combined money changes from R600.00 to R815.00. Sales total R300.00; R40.00 remains owed on S02. Neither R815.00 nor R215.00 is established accounting profit. The pack omits production costs and stock values needed for that conclusion.
draft: Voltooi al sewe geldrye. Die plaas ontvang R260.00 van kopers en betaal R45.00 in gedokumenteerde koste. Gesamentlike geld verander van R600.00 na R815.00. Verkope beloop R300.00; R40.00 bly verskuldig op S02. Nóg R815.00 nóg R215.00 is vasgestelde rekeningkundige wins. Die pakket laat produksiekoste en voorraadwaardes weg wat vir daardie gevolgtrekking nodig is.

key: A new R90.00 sale has a R30.00 payment. Ask separately for the sale value, money received and amount owed: R90.00, R30.00 and R60.00. Then give the learner a new internal R20.00 transfer between accounts. The transfer alone changes neither total money nor sales. An independently documented R1.00 fee would reduce money by R1.00; it would not make the transfer itself a produce purchase. These are separate practice cases, not extra rows in the main tables.

An independently documented R1.00 fee would reduce money by R1.00; it would not make the transfer itself a produce purchase. These are separate practice cases, not extra rows in the main tables.
draft: 'n Nuwe verkoping van R90.00 het 'n betaling van R30.00. Vra afsonderlik vir die verkoopwaarde, geld ontvang en bedrag verskuldig: R90.00, R30.00 en R60.00. Gee die leerder dan 'n nuwe interne oordrag van R20.00 tussen rekenings. Die oordrag alleen verander nóg totale geld nóg verkope. 'n Onafhanklik gedokumenteerde fooi van R1.00 sou geld met R1.00 verminder; dit sou nie die oordrag self 'n produkaankoop maak nie. Dit is afsonderlike oefengevalle, nie ekstra rye in die hooftabelle nie.

key: If the learner adds the transfer to income, move one physical token between the two account mats and ask how many tokens were created. If a part-payment settles the whole sale in their answer, place the R60.00 payment under the R100.00 sale and uncover the R40.00 gap. If cents disappear, compare PACK01's R12.50 with the written entry before recalculating.

If cents disappear, compare PACK01's R12.50 with the written entry before recalculating.

As 'n gedeeltelike betaling in hul antwoord die hele verkoping vereffen, plaas die R60.00-betaling onder die R100.00-verkoping en ontbloot die R40.00-gaping. As sente verdwyn, vergelyk PACK01 se R12.50 met die geskrewe inskrywing voordat jy weer bereken.

key: The practice book omits FEE01 and reports wallet money of R340.00. The supplied closing wallet statement shows R337.50. Compare the rows, find the R2.50 debit on that statement and add its missing source reference. The book now agrees with the statement. This correction is supported by FEE01, not by a made-up “balancing fee”. If the statement did not show the reason, the difference would remain unresolved.

draft: Die oefenboek laat FEE01 weg en rapporteer beursiegeld van R340.00. Die verskafde beursiestaat by afsluiting wys R337.50. Vergelyk die rye, vind die debiet van R2.50 op daardie staat en voeg sy ontbrekende bronverwysing by. Die boek stem nou met die staat ooreen. Hierdie regstelling word deur FEE01 ondersteun, nie deur 'n versinde “balanseringsfooi” nie. As die staat nie die rede gewys het nie, sou die verskil onopgelos bly.

key: The worksheet gives an 8 kg record changed to “8 bunches”, a Day 2 delivery with a Day 4 payment, and a closing count that is still unexplained. The learner must keep the original measurement unit, preserve both event dates and leave the unknown cause unresolved. Being able to repeat the rule does not pass the task; they must find and explain each discrepancy on a fresh copy.

draft: Die werkblad gee 'n rekord van 8 kg wat na “8 bossies” verander is, 'n aflewering op Dag 2 met 'n betaling op Dag 4, en 'n sluitingstelling wat nog onverklaar is. Die leerder moet die oorspronklike meeteenheid hou, albei gebeurtenisdatums bewaar en die onbekende oorsaak onopgelos laat. Om die reël te kan herhaal, slaag nie die taak nie; hulle moet elke teenstrydigheid op 'n nuwe kopie vind en verduidelik.

key: If the learner changes a source document to fit the total, ask which record was the evidence and which was the copy. If they stop after totals agree, show two offsetting errors: an omitted R5.00 receipt and an omitted R5.00 payment. The net change is zero, but both records are still missing. Ask them to identify the missing events rather than congratulating a balanced total. These two example events are outside the main pack.

As hulle stop nadat totale ooreenstem, wys twee foute wat mekaar opweeg: 'n weggelate kwitansie van R5.00 en 'n weggelate betaling van R5.00. Die netto verandering is nul, maar albei rekords ontbreek steeds. Vra hulle om die ontbrekende gebeure te identifiseer eerder as om 'n gebalanseerde totaal geluk te wens. Hierdie twee voorbeeldgebeure val buite die hoofpakket.

key: The published guides provide save/reopen steps for harvests, costs and invoices. Practise through the existing sample tour in the same tab. The sample farm's edited data lives in memory: a full reload restores its starting data, although the tab can remain in sample mode. Reopening within the same session is the task here; sample persistence does not demonstrate real-account sync. On a real account, read pending/offline messages and check the saved result without entering the same event twice. The harvest list currently has no Edit control; keep the exact correction needed rather than inventing an adjustment harvest.

Om binne dieselfde sessie weer oop te maak, is hier die taak; die voortbestaan van die voorbeeld demonstreer nie sinkronisering van 'n werklike rekening nie. Lees op 'n werklike rekening hangende/vanlyn-boodskappe en kontroleer die gestoorde resultaat sonder om dieselfde gebeurtenis twee keer in te voer. Die oeslys het tans geen Wysig-kontrole nie; hou die presiese regstelling wat nodig is eerder as om 'n aanpassingsoes te versin.

key:
The learner passes the practical task by (a) tracing the 28 kg available into all destinations; (b) matching three sales to payments and retaining S02's R40.00 balance; (c) keeping the internal transfer out of sales and costs; (d) checking cents; and (e) explaining a supported correction and an unresolved difference. Offer a different example after feedback. A guessed zero for missing information or a total that only matches by cancelling errors is not successful reconciliation.

Bied 'n ander voorbeeld ná terugvoer aan. 'n Geraaide nul vir ontbrekende inligting of 'n totaal wat net ooreenstem omdat foute mekaar uitkanselleer, is nie suksesvolle rekonsiliasie nie.

Werkbladantwoorde: voorraadtaak 10 − 3 − 2 − 4 = 1 kg onverklaar; betaaltaak R90.00 − R30.00 = R60.00 verskuldig; oordrag tussen eie rekenings skep geen ekstra gesamentlike geld nie; 'n onafhanklik gedokumenteerde fooi van R1.00 verminder dit met R1.00. Behou vir die veranderde H02-eenheid 8 kg uit die wegingsrekord. Hou Dag 2 as aflewering en Dag 4 as betaling. key: “Which product uses it?” gives direct or shared. “What changes when this activity changes?” gives fixed or variable. Hiring a tool for an agreed day may be direct to one crop but unchanged if that day's output is a little smaller. Extra packaging may vary with packs sold. A shared bill can contain variable items. Always state the period and the change being considered.

Always state the period and the change being considered.
draft: “Watter produk gebruik dit?” gee direk of gedeel. “Wat verander wanneer hierdie aktiwiteit verander?” gee vas of veranderlik. Om 'n stuk gereedskap vir 'n ooreengekome dag te huur, kan direk aan een gewas wees maar onveranderd as daardie dag se uitset 'n bietjie kleiner is. Ekstra verpakking kan wissel met die pakke wat verkoop word. 'n Gedeelde rekening kan veranderlike items bevat. Sê altyd die tydperk en die verandering wat oorweeg word.

key: Allocate both shared bills, add each crop's direct costs and check the combined amount. Then add the separately stated family-time comparison: four hours and six hours at the hypothetical R25.00 per hour. Keep the cash column intact. No payment has been invented, and no family time should be added twice if it is already paid and included elsewhere.

Then add the separately stated family-time comparison: four hours and six hours at the hypothetical R25.00 per hour. Keep the cash column intact. No payment has been invented, and no family time should be added twice if it is already paid and included elsewhere.
draft: Deel albei gedeelde rekenings toe, tel elke gewas se direkte koste by en kontroleer die gesamentlike bedrag. Tel dan die afsonderlik gestelde vergelyking van gesinstyd by: vier uur en ses uur teen die hipotetiese R25.00 per uur. Hou die kontantkolom ongeskonde. Geen betaling is versin nie, en geen gesinstyd moet twee keer bygetel word as dit reeds betaal en elders ingesluit is nie.

key: A new R75.00 hire bill was used one hour by one activity and two hours by another. Divide it and check the sum. Then explain why “shared” does not automatically mean “fixed”. Classify an owner withdrawal and an equipment purchase separately; neither should be hidden inside materials used. Equipment use and its cash purchase may fall in different periods; ask for bookkeeping help on the appropriate treatment.

Classify an owner withdrawal and an equipment purchase separately; neither should be hidden inside materials used. Equipment use and its cash purchase may fall in different periods; ask for bookkeeping help on the appropriate treatment.
draft: 'n Nuwe huurrekening van R75.00 is een uur deur een aktiwiteit en twee uur deur 'n ander gebruik. Verdeel dit en kontroleer die som. Verduidelik dan waarom “gedeel” nie outomaties “vas” beteken nie. Klassifiseer 'n eienaarsonttrekking en 'n aankoop van toerusting afsonderlik; geeneen moet binne gebruikte materiale weggesteek word nie. Die gebruik van toerusting en die kontantaankoop daarvan kan in verskillende tydperke val; vra boekhouhulp oor die gepaste hantering.

key: If both crops receive R120.00, place the single hire receipt between them and ask how the farm obtained two bills. If the learner divides every shared cost equally, ask which source supports the equal split. If family time becomes a cash payment, ask for the payment evidence. Retry with the new hire bill rather than repeating the original numbers.

draft: As albei gewasse R120.00 kry, plaas die enkele huurkwitansie tussen hulle en vra hoe die plaas twee rekenings gekry het. As die leerder elke gedeelde koste gelyk verdeel, vra watter bron die gelyke verdeling ondersteun. As gesinstyd 'n kontantbetaling word, vra vir die betaalbewyse. Probeer weer met die nuwe huurrekening eerder as om die oorspronklike getalle te herhaal.

key:
B01 supplies included fixed costs of R105.00 per practice cycle and variable costs of R7.50 per pack. Each pack is 1 kg and sells for R12.00. For this model only, every pack prepared is sold, price and variable cost stay constant, and fixed costs stay unchanged up to the stated capacity of 30 packs. It is not a forecast derived from the carrot harvest.

Contribution per pack is R12.00 minus R7.50 = R4.50. R105.00 divided by R4.50 is 23 and one-third packs. Whole packs require rounding **up** to 24. Verify on either side: at 23 packs the model is R1.50 short; at 24 it has R3.00 left after its included costs. Call that the model surplus, not full farm profit. This model does not account for prepared-but-unsold packs, waste, changing rates, bad debts or omitted costs. A real plan with those features needs them added explicitly.

B01 supplies included fixed costs of R105.00 per practice cycle and variable costs of R7.50 per pack. Each pack is 1 kg and sells for R12.00. It is not a forecast derived from the carrot harvest.

draft:
B01 verskaf ingesluite vaste koste van R105.00 per oefensiklus en veranderlike koste van R7.50 per pak. Elke pak is 1 kg en verkoop vir R12.00. Slegs vir hierdie model word elke pak wat voorberei word, verkoop, bly prys en veranderlike koste konstant, en bly vaste koste onveranderd tot by die gestelde kapasiteit van 30 pakke. Dit is nie 'n vooruitskatting wat van die wortel-oes afgelei is nie.

Bydrae per pak is R12.00 minus R7.50 = R4.50. R105.00 gedeel deur R4.50 is 23 en een derde pakke. Heel pakke vereis afronding **op** na 24. Verifieer aan weerskante: by 23 pakke kom die model R1.50 kort; by 24 het dit R3.00 oor ná sy ingesluite koste. Noem dit die modeloorskot, nie volle plaaswins nie. Hierdie model hou nie rekening met voorbereide maar onverkoopte pakke, vermorsing, veranderende tariewe, slegte skuld of weggelate koste nie. 'n Werklike plan met daardie kenmerke moet dit eksplisiet byvoeg.

key: A separate card gives included cost R8.00 and selling price R10.00. The difference is R2.00. As a share of cost it is 25% markup; as a share of selling price it is 20% margin on those included costs. These are different denominators. Neither is a complete net-profit margin if costs are missing.
english: A separate card gives included cost R8.00 and selling price R10.00. The difference is R2.00. As a share of cost it is 25% markup; as a share of selling price it is 20% margin on those included costs. These are different denominators. Neither is a complete net-profit margin if costs are missing.
draft: 'n Afsonderlike kaart gee ingesluite koste R8.00 en verkoopprys R10.00. Die verskil is R2.00. As 'n deel van koste is dit 25% opslag; as 'n deel van die verkoopprys is dit 20% marge op daardie ingesluite koste. Dit is verskillende noemers. Geeneen is 'n volledige netto winsmarge as koste ontbreek nie.

key: Use fixed costs R80.00, price R10.00, variable cost R6.00, and capacity 18 whole packs. Find the break-even quantity and explain the capacity problem. Then compare a R6.00 included cost with a R7.50 selling price: calculate markup and margin, naming the denominator each time.
english: Use fixed costs R80.00, price R10.00, variable cost R6.00, and capacity 18 whole packs. Find the break-even quantity and explain the capacity problem. Then compare a R6.00 included cost with a R7.50 selling price: calculate markup and margin, naming the denominator each time.
draft: Gebruik vaste koste R80.00, prys R10.00, veranderlike koste R6.00 en kapasiteit 18 heel pakke. Vind die gelykbreekhoeveelheid en verduidelik die kapasiteitsprobleem. Vergelyk dan 'n ingesluite koste van R6.00 met 'n verkoopprys van R7.50: bereken opslag en marge, en noem elke keer die noemer.

key: For an answer of 23 packs, ask the learner to multiply 23 by R4.50 and compare with R105.00. For “25% margin”, ask “25% of which amount?” For a missing variable cost treated as zero, restore the blank source card and ask what evidence is missing. For “profit”, have the learner name an excluded cost and relabel the result.

draft: Vir 'n antwoord van 23 pakke, vra die leerder om 23 met R4.50 te vermenigvuldig en met R105.00 te vergelyk. Vir “25% marge”, vra “25% van watter bedrag?” Vir 'n ontbrekende veranderlike koste wat as nul behandel is, herstel die leë bronkaart en vra watter bewyse ontbreek. Vir “wins”, laat die leerder 'n uitgeslote koste noem en die resultaat heretiketteer.

key: Prepare one labelled cost-per-unit estimate from agreed practice data. Write the period, costs included, exclusions, unit, expected quantity sold, and source date. Test a smaller sales quantity. Explain what evidence is needed before using the estimate to negotiate a real price.

Toets 'n kleiner verkoopshoeveelheid. Verduidelik watter bewyse nodig is voordat die skatting gebruik word om oor 'n werklike prys te onderhandel.

key: For a fresh 10 kg, a collecting buyer offers R10.00/kg and a delivery buyer R12.00/kg. The delivery charge is missing. key:
The new R75.00 hire allocation is **R25.00 and R50.00**. The new break-even case needs **20 packs**, beyond capacity 18; at 18 its model result is **-R8.00**. R6.00 cost and R7.50 price give **R1.50 difference, 25% markup and 20% margin**. The fresh buyer comparison gives collection value R100.00 versus delivery value R120.00 before the unknown charge: the cash results tie at **R20.00 delivery cost**. Below that charge the delivery offer retains more; above it collection retains more, considering only these stated cash items. With the charge missing, no final ranking follows.

To pass, the learner must allocate each bill once, check the total, name the basis, keep time value separate from cash, use and label a correct denominator, round whole-unit break-even upward, reject a capacity or evidence gap, and compare an offer beyond its price. One correct total with an incorrect explanation is insufficient. Supply a fresh case after feedback; record what the learner actually demonstrates. Completion is evidence of these practice skills, not certification of a business's profitability.

R6.00 cost and R7.50 price give **R1.50 difference, 25% markup and 20% margin**. The fresh buyer comparison gives collection value R100.00 versus delivery value R120.00 before the unknown charge: the cash results tie at **R20.00 delivery cost**. Below that charge the delivery offer retains more; above it collection retains more, considering only these stated cash items. With the charge missing, no final ranking follows.

To pass, the learner must allocate each bill once, check the total, name the basis, keep time value separate from cash, use and label a correct denominator, round whole-unit break-even upward, reject a capacity or evidence gap, and compare an offer beyond its price. draft:
Die nuwe toedeling van die R75.00-huur is **R25.00 en R50.00**. Die nuwe gelykbreekgeval het **20 pakke** nodig, bo kapasiteit 18; by 18 is sy modelresultaat **-R8.00**. 'n Koste van R6.00 en 'n prys van R7.50 gee **'n verskil van R1.50, 25% opslag en 20% marge**. Die nuwe kopervergelyking gee afhaalwaarde R100.00 teenoor afleweringswaarde R120.00 voor die onbekende fooi: die kontantresultate is gelyk by **R20.00 afleweringskoste**. Onder daardie fooi behou die afleweringsaanbod meer; daarbo behou afhaal meer, met inagneming van slegs hierdie gestelde kontantitems. Met die fooi wat ontbreek, volg geen finale rangorde nie.

Om te slaag, moet die leerder elke rekening een keer toedeel, die totaal nagaan, die basis noem, tydwaarde afsonderlik van kontant hou, 'n korrekte noemer gebruik en benoem, gelykbreek in heel eenhede opwaarts afrond, 'n kapasiteits- of bewysgaping verwerp, en 'n aanbod verder as net sy prys vergelyk. Een korrekte totaal met 'n verkeerde verduideliking is onvoldoende. Verskaf 'n nuwe geval ná terugvoer; teken aan wat die leerder werklik demonstreer. Voltooiing is bewys van hierdie oefenvaardighede, nie sertifisering van 'n besigheid se winsgewendheid nie.

key: Build the A and B columns and reconcile their sum to the original shared bills. Explain why paying R250.00 for equipment in March is a cash movement but does not establish a R250.00 cost of equipment use for this activity period. The value of its use and accounting treatment need separate evidence and bookkeeping review. Household withdrawal is also a cash movement, not automatically a crop input.
english: Build the A and B columns and reconcile their sum to the original shared bills. Explain why paying R250.00 for equipment in March is a cash movement but does not establish a R250.00 cost of equipment use for this activity period. The value of its use and accounting treatment need separate evidence and bookkeeping review. Household withdrawal is also a cash movement, not automatically a crop input.
draft: Bou die A- en B-kolomme en versoen hul som met die oorspronklike gedeelde rekenings. Verduidelik waarom die betaling van R250.00 vir toerusting in Maart 'n kontantbeweging is, maar nie 'n koste van R250.00 vir die gebruik van toerusting vir hierdie aktiwiteitstydperk bewys nie. Die waarde van die gebruik daarvan en die rekeningkundige hantering het afsonderlike bewyse en boekhouhersiening nodig. Huishoudelike onttrekking is ook 'n kontantbeweging, nie outomaties 'n gewasinset nie.

key: If the farm total includes both the shared bill and its allocations, physically remove the duplicate card. If unpaid family time becomes a cash payment, ask for payment evidence. If a missing cost becomes zero, replace the zero with an unresolved source request. Give a fresh allocation after feedback.

key: The [expense companion](https://imbewufield.vercel.app/student/guides/expenses) helps find actual recorded costs. It does not create this forecast. draft: Open in 'n afsonderlike voorbeeld met R90.00; betaal R130.00 op Dag 2, ontvang R80.00 op Dag 10 en betaal R20.00 op Dag 20. Vir 'n faktuur wat as kontant getel is, plaas sy beloofde ontvangs op die latere datum. Vra vir 'n nuwe gedateerde voorbeeld ná regstelling.

key: LOW reduces B's expected sales and receipt from R500.00 to R350.00; this is a lower-sales case, not a claim that a R500.00 debt has been settled in full. OUTSIDE moves B's same R500.00 receipt to 20 April, beyond the 31 March horizon. It remains an expected amount owed, not vanished money; exclude it from cash received inside the horizon. UNKNOWN removes B's input quote. Later exact balances and the deepest gap become unknown, not larger positive balances caused by treating a blank as free.

draft: LOW verminder B se verwagte verkope en ontvangs van R500.00 na R350.00; dit is 'n geval van laer verkope, nie 'n bewering dat 'n skuld van R500.00 ten volle vereffen is nie. OUTSIDE skuif B se selfde ontvangs van R500.00 na 20 April, buite die horison van 31 Maart. Dit bly 'n verwagte bedrag verskuldig, nie geld wat verdwyn het nie; sluit dit uit van kontant ontvang binne die horison. UNKNOWN verwyder B se insetkwotasie. Latere presiese saldo's en die diepste gaping word onbekend, nie groter positiewe saldo's wat veroorsaak word deur 'n leë waarde as gratis te behandel nie.

key: A good response names the affected date and amount, what can actually change, what must be agreed, and the consequences for later costs, production and receipts. After corrective feedback, use fresh dates or values. For a redacted local practice plan, keep base and adverse cases side by side, label assumptions and set a review date. Compare actual evidence with the plan when it arrives; retain the original forecast rather than rewriting it to pretend it predicted the outcome.

Vergelyk werklike bewyse met die plan wanneer dit opdaag; behou die oorspronklike vooruitskatting eerder as om dit te herskryf om voor te gee dat dit die uitkoms voorspel het.

key: Give the learner four new blank document cards. Read aloud: an agreement is made, produce is delivered, an invoice is issued, and a buyer pays only some of it later. Ask the learner to place each card in the correct sequence and identify the evidence still needed. Then supply the independent R150.00 invoice and R50.00 receipt. Ask for the recorded amount still owed and what would prove settlement.

Vra die leerder om elke kaart in die regte volgorde te plaas en die bewyse te identifiseer wat nog nodig is. Verskaf dan die onafhanklike faktuur van R150.00 en ontvangs van R50.00. key:
Sort these situations: (a) an invoice already saved; (b) an eligible sale already recorded with no invoice; (c) a completed sale not yet recorded; (d) an old paper invoice whose sale may already exist. Explain the lookup step and route for each. For (d), missing evidence about an existing sale stays unresolved until checked. “Paper” does not mean “unpaid”.

Use the prepared sample invoice to demonstrate unpaid → paid in full only when the exercise supplies full payment evidence. Keep the same invoice identity. A receipt date and invoice issue date answer different questions. The current app gives the whole paid invoice one receipt date in its records/chart series. For instalments on different dates, the separate supporting schedule must retain each actual receipt date; the app chart cannot represent that full cash history. If the app does not support the original record faithfully, retain it separately and identify the limitation instead of manufacturing a replacement history.

Verduidelik die opsoekstap en roete vir elkeen. Vir (d) bly ontbrekende bewyse oor 'n bestaande verkoping onopgelos totdat dit nagegaan is. “Papier” beteken nie “onbetaal” nie.

Gebruik die voorbereide voorbeeldfaktuur om onbetaal → ten volle betaal te demonstreer slegs wanneer die oefening bewys van volle betaling verskaf. Hou dieselfde faktuuridentiteit. 'n Ontvangsdatum en faktuuruitreikdatum beantwoord verskillende vrae. Die huidige app gee die hele betaalde faktuur een ontvangsdatum in sy rekords-/grafiekreeks. Vir paaiemente op verskillende datums moet die afsonderlike ondersteunende skedule elke werklike ontvangsdatum behou; die app se grafiek kan nie daardie volle kontantgeskiedenis voorstel nie. As die app nie die oorspronklike rekord getrou ondersteun nie, behou dit afsonderlik en identifiseer die beperking in plaas daarvan om 'n vervangende geskiedenis te vervaardig.

key: Present a saved R150.00 invoice and the R50.00 receipt from F5.1. Vra of 'n tweede verkoping van R50.00 geskep moet word, die oorspronklike as ten volle betaal gemerk moet word, of die gedeeltelike betaling in 'n afsonderlike nagegaande saldorekord gehou moet word. Slegs die laaste pas by hierdie feite. Vra dan wat ondersoek moet word voordat 'n gevraagde afskrif van die bestaande faktuur afgelaai word.

Vir veranderde datums, gaan terug na oorspronklike bewyse. Maak in die voorbeeldwerkruimte een voorbereide faktuur weer oop en identifiseer sy bedrag, betaalstatus en bron. key:
Day 1 order O02 is R90.00. Day 2 advance DEP02 is R30.00; nothing has been delivered and no invoice issued in this exercise. Cash received is R30.00 and the customer's advance remains separately held in the record. This describes an outstanding obligation, not a promise that a separate physical bank account exists. It does not establish completed sales revenue.

Day 5 completed delivery and invoice D02-I02 is R90.00. First identify the original R30.00 receipt, then record ALLOC02 applying it to this invoice. After that allocation, recorded amount owed is R60.00, advance held is zero and total cash received remains R30.00. The intermediate table row before allocation deliberately leaves the deposit separate until matched. Day 6 receipt R02 of R60.00 settles the balance. Total cash collected is R90.00, not R120.00. Real deposits, cancellations, refund terms and tax timing require the actual agreement and local bookkeeping guidance; this pack invents none.

Dag 1 bestelling O02 is R90.00. Dag 2 voorskot DEP02 is R30.00; niks is afgelewer nie en geen faktuur is in hierdie oefening uitgereik nie. Kontant ontvang is R30.00 en die kliënt se voorskot bly afsonderlik in die rekord gehou. Dit beskryf 'n uitstaande verpligting, nie 'n belofte dat 'n afsonderlike fisiese bankrekening bestaan nie. Dit bewys nie voltooide verkoopsinkomste nie.

Dag 5 voltooide aflewering en faktuur D02-I02 is R90.00. Identifiseer eers die oorspronklike ontvangs van R30.00, en teken dan ALLOC02 aan wat dit op hierdie faktuur toepas. Ná daardie toedeling is die aangetekende bedrag verskuldig R60.00, die voorskot wat gehou word nul en die totale kontant ontvang bly R30.00. Die tussentydse tabelry voor toedeling laat die deposito doelbewus afsonderlik totdat dit gepas is. Dag 6 ontvangs R02 van R60.00 vereffen die saldo. Totale kontant ingevorder is R90.00, nie R120.00 nie. Werklike deposito's, kansellasies, terugbetalingsvoorwaardes en belastingtydsberekening vereis die werklike ooreenkoms en plaaslike boekhoudleiding; hierdie pakket versin niks daarvan nie.

key: Invoice D03-I03 is R200.00; R03-A confirms R120.00 received. Q03 records that the customer questions R40.00. Keep the issue and evidence visible. Merely entering that question does not turn the R80.00 recorded balance into zero or establish that the disputed amount is legally owed. Investigate the delivery, price and agreement. For this synthetic case only, ADJ03 is a separately documented, approved R20.00 reduction. Retain the original invoice and adjustment trail. The resulting recorded balance is R60.00. Receipt R03-B of R60.00 settles it. This is a bookkeeping exercise, not advice to demand a disputed amount or authority to create a tax credit note in the app.

Receipt R03-B of R60.00 settles it. This is a bookkeeping exercise, not advice to demand a disputed amount or authority to create a tax credit note in the app.
draft: Faktuur D03-I03 is R200.00; R03-A bevestig R120.00 ontvang. Q03 teken aan dat die kliënt R40.00 bevraagteken. Hou die kwessie en bewyse sigbaar. Om daardie vraag bloot in te voer, verander nie die aangetekende saldo van R80.00 in nul nie en bewys nie dat die betwiste bedrag wettig verskuldig is nie. Ondersoek die aflewering, prys en ooreenkoms. Slegs vir hierdie sintetiese geval is ADJ03 'n afsonderlik gedokumenteerde, goedgekeurde vermindering van R20.00. Behou die oorspronklike faktuur en aanpassingspoor. Die gevolglike aangetekende saldo is R60.00. Ontvangs R03-B van R60.00 vereffen dit. Dit is 'n boekhouoefening, nie advies om 'n betwiste bedrag te eis of magtiging om 'n belastingkredietnota in die app te skep nie.

key: Invoice D05-I05 is R50.00; R05 proves receipt of R60.00. Only R50.00 settles that invoice. Keep the extra R10.00 as an unresolved customer credit; it is not extra produce revenue or automatically a tip. Confirm an appropriate agreed treatment and its evidence. This exercise performs no refund, future-sale allocation or financial transfer.

draft: Faktuur D05-I05 is R50.00; R05 bewys ontvangs van R60.00. Slegs R50.00 vereffen daardie faktuur. Hou die ekstra R10.00 as 'n onopgeloste kliëntkrediet; dit is nie ekstra produkinkomste of outomaties 'n fooitjie nie. Bevestig 'n gepaste ooreengekome hantering en die bewyse daarvan. Hierdie oefening voer geen terugbetaling, toedeling aan 'n toekomstige verkoping of finansiële oordrag uit nie.

key: Invoice R150.00, received R50.00. The buyer questions R30.00; no change has been approved. State the recorded balance and label the unresolved question. Explain why the app's paid-in-full control cannot represent the first part-payment history or the credit ledger.

draft: Faktuur R150.00, ontvang R50.00. Die koper bevraagteken R30.00; geen verandering is goedgekeur nie. Sê die aangetekende saldo en merk die onopgeloste vraag. Dan word 'n bewysgesteunde vermindering van R10.00 goedgekeur: bereken weer. In 'n afsonderlike geval, faktuur R35.00 en ontvangs R40.00: identifiseer die krediet. Verduidelik waarom die app se ten volle betaal-kontrole nie die eerste gedeeltelike betaalgeskiedenis of die kredietgrootboek kan voorstel nie.

key: A different hire costs R80.00, plus a R50.00 security deposit returned fully later. Find the amount needed before hire and net cash paid after refund. Then remove the refund agreement: which conclusion is no longer established? For a shared tool, name the missing agreement if two members need the same slot.

draft: 'n Ander huur kos R80.00, plus 'n sekuriteitsdeposito van R50.00 wat later ten volle terugbetaal word. Vind die bedrag wat voor die huur nodig is en die netto kontant betaal ná terugbetaling. Verwyder dan die terugbetalingsooreenkoms: watter gevolgtrekking is nie meer bewys nie? Noem vir 'n gedeelde stuk gereedskap die ontbrekende ooreenkoms as twee lede dieselfde tydgleuf nodig het.

key:
In this original model, R600.00 principal is advanced on 1 January 2027 and credited in full. A R30.00 fee is paid separately that day, leaving R570.00 from the advance available for the intended purpose. The quoted schedule has three principal payments of R200.00. Interest components are R12.00, R8.00 and R4.00. Each instalment also includes R6.00 service and R4.00 required insurance. No optional insurance or other charges are assumed in this model. These are supplied charge amounts, not an interest calculation or a statement that such terms comply with law.

The payments due are R222.00 on 31 January, R218.00 on 28 February and R214.00 on 31 March. Their total is R654.00. With the separate R30.00 fee, total outflow is R684.00 against the R600.00 gross advance. Specified financing charges are R84.00: interest R24.00, service R18.00, insurance R12.00 and the initial fee R30.00. Repaying R600.00 principal is not an additional R600.00 interest expense or produce sale. Remaining principal is R400.00, R200.00 and zero after the three scheduled payments. That number excludes future charges; label it remaining principal, not a complete early-settlement quote.

key: Start a new case with R400.00 total and no reserve. Earmark R90.00. Then pay R20.00 from that reserve. State total cash after the allocation and after the external payment, including what remains reserved. Explain why a non-cash cost estimate cannot pay the next repair.

Cash receipts total R1300: R200 old balance + R600 current receipt + R500 borrowing. Payments total R1190. Opening R1000 + R1300 − R1190 = closing cash R1110, an increase of R110. February's R300 receipt is excluded. This is a cash summary; it is not a standards-compliant statement of cash flows with all classifications and disclosures.

Sales R900 less goods supplied R350, interest R10, transport R80, utilities R60, stock loss R50 and depreciation R60 gives **R290 result before tax in this model**. No tax amount is inferred. Closing assets are cash R1110 + customers owing R300 + stock R300 + equipment R840 + prepayment R120 = R2670. Liabilities are supplier/service balances R330 + loan R400 = R730. Equity is R1940. Check R2670 = R730 + R1940, and R1800 opening equity + R290 result − R150 personal withdrawal = R1940.

key:
Place A01 across the January–February boundary. Work was completed in January at the agreed R80 charge. The invoice is dated February and the amount is unpaid at January end. Under this model, January includes the R80 cost and liability, while January cash does not change. Retain both documents and dates. Now place F01: cash leaves in January, but the whole storage service is for February. January includes a R120 prepayment asset, not a January storage cost. A real contract may need different treatment; this case supplies the timing and rights explicitly.

Show the stock bridge: opening R300 + purchases R400 − goods supplied R350 = R350 before the closing check. C01 supports a R50 loss and R300 remaining. This is a reviewed reconciliation, not an instruction to label every unexplained difference as theft or spoilage. Ask for evidence before choosing a cause or accounting treatment. Show the equipment bridge: opening R600 + purchase R300 − supplied period depreciation R60 = R840. The charge spreads cost in this model but is not a new payment and is not a tax allowance.

Die faktuur is in Februarie gedateer en die bedrag is aan die einde van Januarie onbetaal. Onder hierdie model sluit Januarie die koste en las van R80 in, terwyl Januarie se kontant nie verander nie. Behou albei dokumente en datums. Plaas nou F01: kontant gaan in Januarie uit, maar die hele bergingsdiens is vir Februarie. Januarie sluit 'n vooruitbetalingsbate van R120 in, nie 'n bergingskoste vir Januarie nie. 'n Werklike kontrak kan 'n ander hantering nodig hê; hierdie geval verskaf die tydsberekening en regte uitdruklik.

Wys die voorraadbrug: opening R300 + aankope R400 − goedere verskaf R350 = R350 voor die sluitingskontrole. C01 ondersteun 'n verlies van R50 en R300 oorblywend. Dit is 'n hersiene rekonsiliasie, nie 'n opdrag om elke onverklaarde verskil as diefstal of bederf te merk nie. Vra vir bewyse voordat 'n oorsaak of rekeningkundige hantering gekies word. Die heffing versprei koste in hierdie model, maar is nie 'n nuwe betaling nie en is nie 'n belastingtoelaag nie.
