draft: Hou kontantontvangste, toewysings, aanpassings en vrae apart; verduidelik 'n oorblywende saldo; en weet wanneer die huidige app 'n aparte stawende skedule nodig het.

key: Compare the same service need, identify cash tied up before use, retain missing information, and explain why a low purchase contribution does not prove a tool will be available.
english: Compare the same service need, identify cash tied up before use, retain missing information, and explain why a low purchase contribution does not prove a tool will be available.
draft: Vergelyk dieselfde diensbehoefte, identifiseer kontant wat voor gebruik vasgelê is, behou ontbrekende inligting, en verduidelik waarom 'n lae aankoopbydrae nie bewys dat 'n stuk gereedskap beskikbaar sal wees nie.

key: Reconcile money received, fees, principal and repayment dates; recognise an incomplete quote; and connect a proposed repayment to a dated cash plan without claiming that arithmetic alone proves affordability.
english: Reconcile money received, fees, principal and repayment dates; recognise an incomplete quote; and connect a proposed repayment to a dated cash plan without claiming that arithmetic alone proves affordability.
draft: Versoen ontvangde geld, fooie, hoofsom en terugbetalingsdatums; herken 'n onvolledige kwotasie; en koppel 'n voorgestelde terugbetaling aan 'n gedateerde kontantplan sonder om te beweer dat rekenkunde alleen bewys dat dit bekostigbaar is.

key: Distinguish a reserve allocation from money received or spent, retain restricted/earmarked funds in the correct scope, and identify a later cash gap after an unexpected repair.
english: Distinguish a reserve allocation from money received or spent, retain restricted/earmarked funds in the correct scope, and identify a later cash gap after an unexpected repair.
draft: Onderskei 'n reserwetoewysing van geld wat ontvang of bestee is, hou beperkte/geoormerkte fondse in die korrekte omvang, en identifiseer 'n latere kontantgaping ná 'n onverwagte herstelwerk.

key: Point to the record that answers each question: what cash moved during a period; what income and costs belong to that period; and what the business owns and owes at a date. Explain why one total cannot answer all three.
english: Point to the record that answers each question: what cash moved during a period; what income and costs belong to that period; and what the business owns and owes at a date. Explain why one total cannot answer all three.
draft: Wys na die rekord wat elke vraag beantwoord: watter kontant het gedurende 'n tydperk beweeg; watter inkomste en koste behoort aan daardie tydperk; en wat die besigheid op 'n datum besit en skuld. Verduidelik waarom een totaal nie al drie kan beantwoord nie.

key: Separate event, document and payment dates. Explain why stock, equipment, unpaid costs and future services matter at the period boundary. Keep an unsupported value unknown.
english: Separate event, document and payment dates. Explain why stock, equipment, unpaid costs and future services matter at the period boundary. Keep an unsupported value unknown.
draft: Skei gebeurtenis-, dokument- en betalingsdatums. Verduidelik waarom voorraad, toerusting, onbetaalde koste en toekomstige dienste by die grens van die tydperk saak maak. Hou 'n ongestaafde waarde onbekend.

key: Assemble an evidence pack and find the appropriate current official guidance. Distinguish a readable app invoice from a verified compliant tax invoice. State what remains unconfirmed without guessing a tax rate, deadline or registration outcome.
english: Assemble an evidence pack and find the appropriate current official guidance. Distinguish a readable app invoice from a verified compliant tax invoice. State what remains unconfirmed without guessing a tax rate, deadline or registration outcome.
draft: Stel 'n bewyspakket saam en vind die gepaste huidige amptelike riglyne. Onderskei 'n leesbare app-faktuur van 'n geverifieerde belastingfaktuur wat aan die vereistes voldoen. Sê wat onbevestig bly sonder om 'n belastingkoers, sperdatum of registrasie-uitkoms te raai.

key: Compare two options using demand evidence, the same period, available resources and dated cash needs; explain a missing assumption before choosing a next action.
english: Compare two options using demand evidence, the same period, available resources and dated cash needs; explain a missing assumption before choosing a next action.
draft: Vergelyk twee opsies met behulp van bewyse van vraag, dieselfde tydperk, beskikbare hulpbronne en gedateerde kontantbehoeftes; verduidelik 'n ontbrekende aanname voordat jy 'n volgende aksie kies.

key: Present a connected plan whose claims lead back to evidence, show timing and constraints, and distinguish an unapproved funding request from available cash.
english: Present a connected plan whose claims lead back to evidence, show timing and constraints, and distinguish an unapproved funding request from available cash.
draft: Bied 'n samehangende plan aan waarvan die bewerings terugvoer na bewyse, wys tydsberekening en beperkings, en onderskei 'n onbewilligde befondsingsversoek van beskikbare kontant.

key: Reconcile an original forecast with actual records, separate quantity, price, collection and cost differences, preserve a missing value, and set a justified next action.
english: Reconcile an original forecast with actual records, separate quantity, price, collection and cost differences, preserve a missing value, and set a justified next action.
draft: Versoen 'n oorspronklike vooruitskatting met werklike rekords, skei verskille in hoeveelheid, prys, invordering en koste, behou 'n ontbrekende waarde, en stel 'n geregverdigde volgende aksie.

key: A buyer can take produce today and pay later. Record the sale and what the buyer owes. When the payment arrives, match it to that sale. The payment clears the amount owed; it is not a second basket sold. Cash answers how much money is available. Profit needs the income and costs for the period. Some costs or stock information may still be missing. Say what you know and what you still need.
english: A buyer can take produce today and pay later. Record the sale and what the buyer owes. When the payment arrives, match it to that sale. The payment clears the amount owed; it is not a second basket sold. Cash answers how much money is available. Profit needs the income and costs for the period. Some costs or stock information may still be missing. Say what you know and what you still need.
draft: 'n Koper kan vandag produkte neem en later betaal. Teken die verkoping aan en wat die koper skuld. Wanneer die betaling aankom, koppel dit aan daardie verkoping. Die betaling vereffen die bedrag wat geskuld word; dit is nie 'n tweede mandjie wat verkoop is nie. Kontant beantwoord hoeveel geld beskikbaar is. Wins het die inkomste en koste vir die tydperk nodig. Sommige koste of voorraadinligting kan nog ontbreek. Sê wat jy weet en wat jy nog nodig het.

key: Start with what was already here. Add what you picked. Record what left and why. A sale, food for home and a gift are different uses. Keep the same unit. At the end, count or weigh what is still here. Compare that with the book. If they differ, look for the cause. A difference is a question to investigate, not proof that someone stole food.
english: Start with what was already here. Add what you picked. Record what left and why. A sale, food for home and a gift are different uses. Keep the same unit. At the end, count or weigh what is still here. Compare that with the book. If they differ, look for the cause. A difference is a question to investigate, not proof that someone stole food.
draft: Begin met wat reeds hier was. Tel by wat jy gepluk het. Teken aan wat weg is en hoekom. 'n Verkoping, kos vir die huis en 'n geskenk is verskillende gebruike. Hou dieselfde eenheid. Tel of weeg aan die einde wat nog hier is. Vergelyk dit met die boek. As hulle verskil, soek die oorsaak. 'n Verskil is 'n vraag om te ondersoek, nie bewys dat iemand kos gesteel het nie.

key:
Write the sale when the agreed produce is delivered in this exercise. Keep the payment beside that sale, with the date it arrived. If only some money arrives, show what is still owed. Moving your own money from the cash tin to the wallet does not create another sale. It changes where the money is kept. A fee is a separate payment if the evidence shows one. Keep the amount and cents from the source.”

This exercise's agreed delivery is the point used to record its sale. It is not a rule covering every contract, deposit, return or accounting policy. Those need their own terms and bookkeeping review.
english:
Write the sale when the agreed produce is delivered in this exercise. Keep the payment beside that sale, with the date it arrived. If only some money arrives, show what is still owed. Moving your own money from the cash tin to the wallet does not create another sale. It changes where the money is kept. A fee is a separate payment if the evidence shows one. Keep the amount and cents from the source.”

This exercise's agreed delivery is the point used to record its sale. It is not a rule covering every contract, deposit, return or accounting policy. Those need their own terms and bookkeeping review.
draft:
Skryf die verkoping neer wanneer die ooreengekome produkte in hierdie oefening afgelewer word. Hou die betaling langs daardie verkoping, met die datum waarop dit aangekom het. As net 'n deel van die geld aankom, wys wat nog geskuld word. Om jou eie geld van die kontantblik na die beursie te skuif, skep nie nog 'n verkoping nie. Dit verander waar die geld gehou word. 'n Fooi is 'n aparte betaling as die bewyse een toon. Hou die bedrag en sente van die bron.”

Hierdie oefening se ooreengekome aflewering is die punt wat gebruik word om sy verkoping aan te teken. Dit is nie 'n reël wat elke kontrak, deposito, terugsending of rekeningkundige beleid dek nie. Daardie het hul eie bepalings en boekhoudkundige hersiening nodig.

key: A cost per unit needs two things: the costs you included and the quantity you divided by. Say both. Produce available for sale is not always produce sold. A selling price may cover some costs and still leave others unpaid. Contribution is what remains after the included variable costs. It must still cover fixed costs. A break-even answer is useful only when its assumptions fit and the required sales can be achieved.
english: A cost per unit needs two things: the costs you included and the quantity you divided by. Say both. Produce available for sale is not always produce sold. A selling price may cover some costs and still leave others unpaid. Contribution is what remains after the included variable costs. It must still cover fixed costs. A break-even answer is useful only when its assumptions fit and the required sales can be achieved.
draft: 'n Koste per eenheid het twee dinge nodig: die koste wat jy ingesluit het en die hoeveelheid waardeur jy gedeel het. Sê albei. Produkte beskikbaar vir verkoop is nie altyd produkte wat verkoop is nie. 'n Verkoopprys kan sommige koste dek en steeds ander onbetaal laat. Bydrae is wat oorbly ná die ingeslote veranderlike koste. Dit moet steeds vaste koste dek. 'n Gelykbreek-antwoord is slegs nuttig wanneer sy aannames pas en die vereiste verkope bereik kan word.

key: Compare the whole offer. Check the weight, quality, price, packaging, delivery and payment date. Use the same unit for both buyers. A higher price can leave less after delivery. Money promised for next week is not money available today. Write down what is agreed, and check what is still unknown before choosing.
english: Compare the whole offer. Check the weight, quality, price, packaging, delivery and payment date. Use the same unit for both buyers. A higher price can leave less after delivery. Money promised for next week is not money available today. Write down what is agreed, and check what is still unknown before choosing.
draft: Vergelyk die hele aanbod. Kontroleer die gewig, gehalte, prys, verpakking, aflewering en betaaldatum. Gebruik dieselfde eenheid vir albei kopers. 'n Hoër prys kan ná aflewering minder oorlaat. Geld wat vir volgende week belowe is, is nie geld wat vandag beskikbaar is nie. Skryf neer wat ooreengekom is, en kontroleer wat nog onbekend is voordat jy kies.

key: Start with money that is available at the beginning. Add a receipt when you expect the money to arrive. Subtract a payment when it must leave. Carry the balance to the next date. An invoice is not cash received. Check the dates between month ends too. A good total at the end cannot pay a bill that comes before the money arrives.
english: Start with money that is available at the beginning. Add a receipt when you expect the money to arrive. Subtract a payment when it must leave. Carry the balance to the next date. An invoice is not cash received. Check the dates between month ends too. A good total at the end cannot pay a bill that comes before the money arrives.
draft: Begin met geld wat aan die begin beskikbaar is. Tel 'n ontvangs by wanneer jy verwag dat die geld sal aankom. Trek 'n betaling af wanneer dit moet uitgaan. Dra die saldo oor na die volgende datum. 'n Faktuur is nie kontant ontvang nie. Kontroleer ook die datums tussen maandeindes. 'n Goeie totaal aan die einde kan nie 'n rekening betaal wat kom voordat die geld aankom nie.

key: Ask what changes if the buyer pays late, less produce sells, or an input costs more. Change the matching card and recalculate from that point onward. A delay changes when cash arrives. A lower sale changes how much arrives. Test them together too. Write down the evidence needed for your response, and check the plan again before committing.
english: Ask what changes if the buyer pays late, less produce sells, or an input costs more. Change the matching card and recalculate from that point onward. A delay changes when cash arrives. A lower sale changes how much arrives. Test them together too. Write down the evidence needed for your response, and check the plan again before committing.
draft: Vra wat verander as die koper laat betaal, minder produkte verkoop, of 'n inset meer kos. Verander die ooreenstemmende kaart en herbereken van daardie punt af. 'n Vertraging verander wanneer kontant aankom. 'n Laer verkoping verander hoeveel aankom. Toets hulle ook saam. Skryf die bewyse neer wat vir jou reaksie nodig is, en kontroleer die plan weer voordat jy jou verbind.

key: Keep the story of one sale together. First, agree what the buyer wants and how payment will work. Check what you deliver. Check the invoice against that delivery and the agreed price. When money arrives, match it to the same invoice. The payment does not create another basket of produce. Keep its date and reference so you can show what is still owed.
english: Keep the story of one sale together. First, agree what the buyer wants and how payment will work. Check what you deliver. Check the invoice against that delivery and the agreed price. When money arrives, match it to the same invoice. The payment does not create another basket of produce. Keep its date and reference so you can show what is still owed.
draft: Hou die storie van een verkoping bymekaar. Kom eers ooreen wat die koper wil hê en hoe betaling sal werk. Kontroleer wat jy aflewer. Kontroleer die faktuur teen daardie aflewering en die ooreengekome prys. Wanneer geld aankom, koppel dit aan dieselfde faktuur. Die betaling skep nie nog 'n mandjie produkte nie. Hou sy datum en verwysing sodat jy kan wys wat nog geskuld word.

key: Start with the work you need done and the dates. Ask what each offer includes. Buying, hiring and sharing move money at different times. A deposit may come back later, but you still need it before use. Keep the value of a tool you still own separate from cash in your hand. Check who can use a shared tool, when it is available and who pays for damage or repairs.
english: Start with the work you need done and the dates. Ask what each offer includes. Buying, hiring and sharing move money at different times. A deposit may come back later, but you still need it before use. Keep the value of a tool you still own separate from cash in your hand. Check who can use a shared tool, when it is available and who pays for damage or repairs.
draft: Begin met die werk wat jy gedoen wil hê en die datums. Vra wat elke aanbod insluit. Koop, huur en deel skuif geld op verskillende tye. 'n Deposito kan later terugkom, maar jy het dit steeds voor gebruik nodig. Hou die waarde van gereedskap wat jy nog besit apart van kontant in jou hand. Kontroleer wie gedeelde gereedskap kan gebruik, wanneer dit beskikbaar is en wie vir skade of herstelwerk betaal.

key: Setting money aside gives it a job. It does not create more money. If you move it between two accounts you own, the total is unchanged unless there is a fee. When you pay someone else for a repair, money leaves. Keep the amount still set aside separate from money for daily work. A reserve target is a plan, not an account balance.
english: Setting money aside gives it a job. It does not create more money. If you move it between two accounts you own, the total is unchanged unless there is a fee. When you pay someone else for a repair, money leaves. Keep the amount still set aside separate from money for daily work. A reserve target is a plan, not an account balance.
draft: Om geld opsy te sit, gee dit 'n taak. Dit skep nie meer geld nie. As jy dit tussen twee rekeninge skuif wat jy besit, is die totaal onveranderd tensy daar 'n fooi is. Wanneer jy iemand anders vir 'n herstelwerk betaal, gaan geld uit. Hou die bedrag wat nog opsy gesit is apart van geld vir daaglikse werk. 'n Reserweteiken is 'n plan, nie 'n rekeningsaldo nie.

key: Start by saying which business and which dates you mean. Our stall starts with money, stock, equipment and amounts owed. A cash summary follows money received and paid. A profit-and-loss view follows the period's income and costs. A balance sheet shows the position on a date: assets, liabilities and what remains for the owner. The views are connected, but their totals need not match. Borrowed money increases cash and debt. It does not become a sale. A customer can owe us for goods already delivered. That sale can be recorded before the money reaches us.
english: Start by saying which business and which dates you mean. Our stall starts with money, stock, equipment and amounts owed. A cash summary follows money received and paid. A profit-and-loss view follows the period's income and costs. A balance sheet shows the position on a date: assets, liabilities and what remains for the owner. The views are connected, but their totals need not match. Borrowed money increases cash and debt. It does not become a sale. A customer can owe us for goods already delivered. That sale can be recorded before the money reaches us.
draft: Begin deur te sê watter besigheid en watter datums jy bedoel. Ons stalletjie begin met geld, voorraad, toerusting en bedrae wat geskuld word. 'n Kontantopsomming volg geld wat ontvang en betaal is. 'n Wins-en-verliesaansig volg die tydperk se inkomste en koste. 'n Balansstaat wys die posisie op 'n datum: bates, laste en wat vir die eienaar oorbly. Die aansigte is verbind, maar hul totale hoef nie ooreen te stem nie. Geleende geld verhoog kontant en skuld. Dit word nie 'n verkoping nie. 'n Kliënt kan ons skuld vir goedere wat reeds afgelewer is. Daardie verkoping kan aangeteken word voordat die geld ons bereik.

key: Start with a buyer and a task you can deliver. What does the buyer need? How much, in which unit, at what quality, and by when? Interest is not an order. A high sales total does not tell you what you will keep or whether you can pay the earlier bills. Put the alternatives beside each other. Keep the missing evidence visible.
english: Start with a buyer and a task you can deliver. What does the buyer need? How much, in which unit, at what quality, and by when? Interest is not an order. A high sales total does not tell you what you will keep or whether you can pay the earlier bills. Put the alternatives beside each other. Keep the missing evidence visible.
draft: Begin met 'n koper en 'n taak wat jy kan lewer. Wat het die koper nodig? Hoeveel, in watter eenheid, van watter gehalte, en teen wanneer? Belangstelling is nie 'n bestelling nie. 'n Hoë verkopetotaal sê nie vir jou wat jy sal hou of of jy die vroeëre rekeninge kan betaal nie. Sit die alternatiewe langs mekaar. Hou die ontbrekende bewyse sigbaar.

key: A useful plan lets another person follow your reasoning. Say what you intend to sell, why a buyer may want it, and what you need to deliver it. Show the work and payments in order. Keep estimates separate from records. If a number or permission is missing, name it and say how you will check it. A neat document cannot turn an application into money.
english: A useful plan lets another person follow your reasoning. Say what you intend to sell, why a buyer may want it, and what you need to deliver it. Show the work and payments in order. Keep estimates separate from records. If a number or permission is missing, name it and say how you will check it. A neat document cannot turn an application into money.
draft: 'n Nuttige plan laat 'n ander persoon jou redenasie volg. Sê wat jy van plan is om te verkoop, waarom 'n koper dit dalk wil hê, en wat jy nodig het om dit te lewer. Wys die werk en betalings in volgorde. Hou skattings apart van rekords. As 'n getal of toestemming ontbreek, noem dit en sê hoe jy dit sal nagaan. 'n Netjiese dokument kan nie 'n aansoek in geld verander nie.

key: Keep the plan you started with. Put the actual records beside it for the same period and units. What sold? What money arrived? What was paid? Which amounts are still owed? Explain each difference with evidence before saying why it happened. Then make the next plan. Changing the old plan to match the result hides what you learned.
english: Keep the plan you started with. Put the actual records beside it for the same period and units. What sold? What money arrived? What was paid? Which amounts are still owed? Explain each difference with evidence before saying why it happened. Then make the next plan. Changing the old plan to match the result hides what you learned.
draft: Hou die plan waarmee jy begin het. Sit die werklike rekords daarlangs vir dieselfde tydperk en eenhede. Wat is verkoop? Watter geld het aangekom? Wat is betaal? Watter bedrae word nog geskuld? Verduidelik elke verskil met bewyse voordat jy sê waarom dit gebeur het. Maak dan die volgende plan. Om die ou plan te verander sodat dit by die resultaat pas, versteek wat jy geleer het.

english: Prepare records and ask the right tax questions
draft: Berei rekords voor en vra die regte belastingvrae

english: Lowest forecast cash balance, including any gap as a negative number
draft: Laagste vooruitgeskatte kontantsaldo, met enige gaping as 'n negatiewe getal

english: Closing cash in the original forecast
draft: Sluitingskontant in die oorspronklike vooruitskatting

english: Value of produce actually delivered and invoiced
draft: Waarde van produkte wat werklik afgelewer en gefaktureer is

english: Payment received from the buyer within this month

english: Amount the buyer still owes at month end

english: Actual closing cash after all supplied cash movements

key: Actual closing cash minus original forecast closing cash
english: Actual closing cash minus original forecast closing cash
draft: Werklike sluitingskontant minus oorspronklike vooruitgeskatte sluitingskontant

key: Name the order, delivery, invoice and payment references. Explain why they describe one sale. Keep the later payment outside this month. Explain how you would show the unpaid balance without marking the invoice paid in full.
english: Name the order, delivery, invoice and payment references. Explain why they describe one sale. Keep the later payment outside this month. Explain how you would show the unpaid balance without marking the invoice paid in full.
draft: Noem die verwysings van die bestelling, aflewering, faktuur en betaling. Verduidelik waarom hulle een verkoping beskryf. Hou die latere betaling buite hierdie maand. Verduidelik hoe jy die onbetaalde saldo sou wys sonder om die faktuur as ten volle betaal te merk.

key: Keep the original forecast. Identify when cash first falls short and what evidence would be needed before changing the plan. Compare the basket alternative, keeping items and kilograms separate. Check buyer commitment and available work hours.
english: Keep the original forecast. Identify when cash first falls short and what evidence would be needed before changing the plan. Compare the basket alternative, keeping items and kilograms separate. Check buyer commitment and available work hours.
draft: Hou die oorspronklike vooruitskatting. Identifiseer wanneer kontant die eerste keer te kort skiet en watter bewyse nodig sal wees voordat die plan verander word. Vergelyk die mandjie-alternatief, en hou items en kilogram apart. Kontroleer die koper se verbintenis en beskikbare werksure.

key: Explain the effects of quantity, payment timing, actual expenses, funding and household withdrawal. A matching closing total does not prove the plan was followed. Name the source of each difference.
english: Explain the effects of quantity, payment timing, actual expenses, funding and household withdrawal. A matching closing total does not prove the plan was followed. Name the source of each difference.
draft: Verduidelik die uitwerking van hoeveelheid, betaaltydsberekening, werklike uitgawes, befondsing en huishoudelike onttrekking. 'n Ooreenstemmende sluitingstotaal bewys nie dat die plan gevolg is nie. Noem die bron van elke verskil.

key: Explain why the water charge cannot be entered as zero, why closing cash is not full profit, and what evidence is missing. Explain why a mapped plot does not prove land rights or harvest. Classify the funding card as its stated owner contribution or loan, not sales.
english: Explain why the water charge cannot be entered as zero, why closing cash is not full profit, and what evidence is missing. Explain why a mapped plot does not prove land rights or harvest. Classify the funding card as its stated owner contribution or loan, not sales.
draft: Verduidelik waarom die waterheffing nie as nul ingevoer kan word nie, waarom sluitingskontant nie volle wins is nie, en watter bewyse ontbreek. Verduidelik waarom 'n gekarteerde perseel nie grondregte of oes bewys nie. Klassifiseer die befondsingskaart as sy vermelde eienaarsbydrae of lening, nie as verkope nie.

key: Separate household and farm money, follow sales and payments, and keep evidence.
english: Separate household and farm money, follow sales and payments, and keep evidence.
draft: Skei huishouding- en plaasgeld, volg verkope en betalings, en hou bewyse.

key: Follow produce and money, reconcile records and explain corrections.
